gates.requiredDecision: Dataset rights, cohort/date/geography/sample/denominator/quantile and reproducible calculations, or explicit approved retirement with SEO impact. Current404 is not an approved removal.
Accept gold live-feed to manual and four-channel comparison preset to manual differences; existing manual tools are not proven legacy parity.
Approve permanent archival strategy or explicit nonclick historical-source treatment after domain move. No archival host supplied or invented.

Provide important inbound links and legacy404/access-log inventory with authorized source and period; public sitemap is not full indexed footprint.
Choose apex or www explicitly, align canonical/sitemap/redirect and approve removal of opposite rule. Current canonical apex and legacy apex308-to-www stay unchanged.
Approve or reject each proposal: /kalkulator to / and /kalkulator/saham/average to /kalkulator/rata-rata-beli-saham; review old preset and break-even intent. No redirect activated.

Named operator/reviewer, exact SHA/deployments/projects/hostnames, permissions and registrar/DNS/TLS/config snapshot verified on execution day, window and rollback deadline. Old observed IDs are not readiness proof.
Approve business/error/traffic thresholds and decision owner from real baseline; physical-device/field-CWV follow-up still required. Synthetic rollback is not a platform recovery drill.
Explicit production-only indexability plan and later verification, keep Preview SSO/noindex; no current permission to change environment/indexing.

New explicit authorization with final reviewed SHA, candidate and rollback deployments, projects, exact host/path/DNS/alias/canonical/indexing changes, operator, maintenance window and rollback. PR/CI success is not approval.
